QUOTE: `app/actions/remote/channel.ts:1397` (`archiveChannel`) | Remove the current user from the channel locally, instead of stamping `delete_at`. | Stamp `delete_at = now` on the channel locally.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer covers both halves: when archived channels are not viewable, the user is removed from the channel (and kicked out if it is the current channel, per the websocket row); when viewable, the channel is kept and marked deleted via `delete_at`.
